observations: Photo 0: A silver portable speaker with a handle on top, front grille, and two small screens. The brand 'MONDO' is visible on a label on the front grille.
Photo 1: Same speaker from a slightly different angle, showing the same front grille, screens, and control buttons. The screen displays 'Bending My Way (Live)' and 'Neon Radio'.

Photo 2: Close-up of the back label showing 'MONDO BT SPEAKER LARGE', 'Input: 5V 3A 9V 3A', 'Capacity: 6000mAh/66.8Wh', 'FCC ID: 2AKFED200', 'Designed by Defunc', 'Manufactured in China', and 'Hollister, Sweden'.
Photo 3: Side view of the speaker showing the handle, front grille, and control buttons. The screen displays the same song and 'Neon Radio' text.
All photos show the speaker on a wooden surface, with a watermark 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED'.
